# sigma_account_types (Data Source)

Lists Sigma account types. Results preserve Sigma API order; key collections by returned IDs rather than positional indices. Pagination cursors and page sizes are not exposed; this data source retrieves every page.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_types` (Attributes List) Account types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account_types))
- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--account_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `account_types`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Account type ID.
- `is_custom` (Boolean) Whether the type is custom.
- `name` (String) Account type name.
